info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Spruce Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Spruce Notebook Detail Management API enables businesses to create detailed catalogs for Spruce notebooks efficiently. This endpoint allows users to submit comprehensive information about individual notebook models, including specifications, features, and availability. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and inventory specialists who need to maintain accurate records and showcase notebook offerings. By centralizing notebook details, organizations can enhance their product visibility and streamline the cataloging process.

post.summary: Create details for a spruce notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and store details for a spruce notebook, enabling better organization and management of notebook entries.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating details in a spruce notebook. This body should contain all necessary information as defined in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details.

CreateCatalogSpruceNotebookDetailRequest.title: Spruce Notebook Request Body

spruce_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier for the spruce notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of the spruce notebooks requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the operation is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price for the spruce notebook.

CreateCatalogSpruceNotebookDetailRespons.description: This schema represents the response structure for a successful POST operation on the Spruce Notebook details.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource returned in the response. This header specifies the format of the data being sent, which can be useful for clients to understand how to process the response.

x-processing-time.description: Represents the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This header can help clients gauge performance and identify potential delays in response.
